title: Flux linkage depends on the angle to the normal
caption: For the 50-turn coil (A = 0.01 m², B = 0.4 T) the flux linkage is NΦ = NBA cos θ with θ the angle between B and the coil's normal. At θ = 0° it is 0.2 Wb-turns, at 60° it is 0.2 × cos 60° = 0.1 Wb-turns (Φ = 2 × 10⁻³ Wb per turn), and at 90° the field lies in the coil's plane and nothing links it.
alt: Graph of flux linkage against angle: a cosine falling from 0.2 Wb-turns at 0° through 0.1 at 60° to zero at 90°.
description: The horizontal axis is the angle θ between the field and the coil's normal in degrees; the vertical axis is the flux linkage in Wb-turns.
NBA = 50 × 0.4 × 0.01 = 0.2 Wb-turns is the largest linkage, at θ = 0°.
At 90° the field is parallel to the coil's plane and the linkage is zero.

checks.name: no flux linkage when B lies in the coil's plane
